rubric.evidence: Re-verified ChromeStatus API 6320639375966208, webstatus.dev attribution-reporting (discouraged), BCD Attribution-Reporting-Register-Source.json (version_removed: 152), and live MDN Attribution_Reporting_API on 2026-11-27. Preserves stable route /v152/deprecate-and-remove-attribution-reporting-api/, ChromeStatus identity 6320639375966208, demo: null binding, and exact listing H1 'Deprecate and remove: Attribution Reporting API'.

Live MDN check on 2026-11-27 confirmed MDN now publishes complete Attribution Reporting API and header references prominently marked Deprecated / To be removed. Added a top .mdn-card callout (#mdn-coverage) while retaining all local reference-contract.json sections (#syntax, #examples, #browser-compatibility) and immutable conformance assertions intact.

Explains why ARA is being removed following Chrome's third-party cookie decision, enumerates the ignored HTML attributes, dropped HTTP headers, and halted background reporting pipelines, and clarifies migration back to cookie-based or server-side measurement.

Documents Chrome 152/153 removal (reconciling BCD version_removed 152 and ChromeStatus 153), Edge mirroring Chromium, and Firefox/Safari never enabling ARA by default.

All ten reference-contract.json sources plus live-verified MDN Attribution Reporting pages, webstatus.dev, and BCD links use direct hrefs with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; zero retired legacy host URLs.

Upgraded to single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, role='note' on Baseline banner and deprecation .warn-block, captioned tables with <thead>/<tbody> and <th scope='row|col'> inside focusable .table-wrap scroll regions, and <pre tabindex='0'>.

Uses shared /public/styles.css editorial tokens, /public/favicon.svg, logical max-inline-size on .table-wrap with visible :focus-visible outline, and verified zero horizontal overflow on desktop (1280x800) and narrow mobile (360x740).
No Chrome Platform Showcase demo exists for this deprecation/removal entry; demo binding honestly remains null per durable-demo contract.
